newsitem.title: CHINA: Rhine places 32 mln shrs at HK$0.95 each.
newsitem.headline: Rhine places 32 mln shrs at HK$0.95 each.

text.p: Rhine Holdings Ltd Ltd said on Tuesday it would place 32 million new shares, or 15.8 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, to a third party Fu Tat International Ltd at HK$0.95 per share.
The jewellery manufacturer said the HK$30.40 million proceeds would be used for expansion of the company's production facilities in China and existing business operation.
Fu Tat, which does not presently hold any Rhine shares, intends to hold the stake as long term investment, it said.
Trading in Rhine shares, suspended on August 15, is due to resume on Tuesday. The stock closed at HK$1.06 on August 14.
